scope: Restore actual212 taper fade in source exports/live rendering; refine long-bank ends and projecting back crown
Raise ponytail front and temples; soften a narrow slicked-root boundary
Four parameterized ponytails, with separate tight gathered roots/tie
Tilted contoured cap with curved visor, adjustable brim/crown and original RVD/signal graphics
Rebuild triangle cups/back band on current support; continuously smooth T-shirt/button-up/hoodie cloth

ponytail.hairline: Raised front and temple/ear boundary; narrow vertex-alpha edge and backward directional relief

parameters.storage: Device-local choices plus downloadable JSON; not sent to server
parameters.native_reproduction: reproduce214.py + parameters214.py: independent packed scenes; --choices JSON or --preset relaxed/high/compact/full
parameters.head_clearance: A shared smooth departure guide checks the bundle envelope against the head; width develops after the tight root. It does not shrinkwrap free lengths. Blender/portable evaluator and live controls share this construction.

compatibility.212: Viewer now reads real Fade from COLOR_1 instead of opaque dummy COLOR_0. Original212 scenes, GLBs and reference renders are preserved. Its index cache key and manifest changed.
compatibility.214: Authored named RGBA fields are baked into standard COLOR_0, including the secondary hairline material; no custom fade shader required.
compatibility.alpha: BLEND coverage for hairline/fade/tips. This is opacity, not physical transmission.213 glass/lens components remain separate and unchanged.
compatibility.cap_fit: Separate covered masculine taper; ponytail cap has a tall narrow rear port for the range of tie heights. No glasses/head/face displacement.
compatibility.controls: CPU parameter construction is a review tool, not a production native renderer implementation.

protected: Original humanoid Studio and product/protocol repositories

review.passes: Construction review and fresh saved/exported review; affected checks reopened after changes
limits: No full catalogue cross-product or native performance qualification
Standard glTF/Three materials do not reproduce the entire Cycles/AgX lighting pipeline
review.head_clearance_result: No interior samples in the four presets, tight-center case and96 slider-bound combinations; explicit fitted-root zone excluded.

coordinates: Shared Blender Z-up/front -Y; native glTF conversion to Y-up/front +Z. Components stay in shared world coordinates.
lighting: Fixed181 source studio/color management, preserved in saved scenes; same fixed browser lighting approximation, no lighting choice.
